name: Cosmic Encounter
summary: Each player is a unique alien power trying to be first to five colonies on opponents' planets via combat and negotiation.
rules_text: Each player has 5 home planets with 4 ships each, 8 card hand, and a unique alien power. First to 5 foreign colonies wins; simultaneous fifth wins together. On your turn as offense: 1) If you have no encounter cards, discard and draw 8 until you do. 2) Regroup: return 1 ship from warp to any of your colonies. 3) Destiny: draw destiny to determine defender system; if your own color you may target a foreign colony on your home or redraw. 4) Launch: point gate at one planet in defender's system and commit 1-4 ships from your colonies onto gate. 5) Alliance: offense then defense invite other players as allies; allies may commit 1-4 ships. 6) Planning: main players and allies secretly play an encounter card (attack with number, negotiate, or morph) face down, plus reinforcements. 7) Reveal and total: attack values + ships + reinforcements. Higher total wins, defender wins ties unless otherwise. Winners place survivors on target; losers' ships go to warp. Successful defense retrieves ships. Negotiations allow shared rewards or compensation.
rating_reason: Alien powers, negotiations, alliances, hidden encounter cards - ideal bluffing and bargaining.
reasons: scope: spatial_board: out of scope by decision: the game depends on a spatial board (a grid, map, movement or adjacency)
